trends.name: Oil Supply Crisis & Strategic Reserves
trends.summary: IEA warns oil supply shortage will worsen in April, potentially exceeding 1970s oil crises combined. Agency considering further strategic reserve releases. UK facing jet fuel shortage with final vessel arriving in 48 hours. Critical geopolitical factor impacting energy prices and inflation expectations.

trends.name: Middle East Escalation & Strait of Hormuz
trends.summary: UAE reportedly preparing to help US open Strait of Hormuz by force, lobbying for UN Security Council resolution. Iran threatening strikes on major US tech companies including Amazon and Nvidia. Escalating regional tensions directly threatening critical global energy chokepoint and tech infrastructure.

trends.name: Financial Conditions Tightening Rapidly
trends.summary: US Financial Conditions Index at 99.17, tightest since June 2025, with +0.77 point surge in 20 days—fastest pace since March-April 2025. Second-fastest tightening since 2022. Private credit losses creating contagion fears in banking sector, signaling potential liquidity stress.

trends.name: Nvidia & AI Chip Dominance Narrative
trends.summary: Nvidia stock prediction points to $20 trillion market cap potential as AI capacity buildout continues. Meanwhile, Iran threatens Nvidia and other tech giants with attacks. Competing narratives of transformative AI opportunity versus geopolitical vulnerability to critical semiconductor infrastructure.

trends.name: Oracle Cost-Cutting & AI Investment Shift
trends.summary: Oracle planning to cut thousands of jobs to fund AI capacity expansion. Stock rises on cost-cutting announcement. Signals tech sector resource reallocation from traditional operations to AI infrastructure, impacting employment and capex priorities across enterprise software.

trends.name: Employment Data Mixed Signals
trends.summary: Private sector hiring totaled 62,000 in March (better than expected) while median household income metrics tracked for February 2026. Employers using personal data to suppress wage offers. Conflicting signals on labor market health amid broader cost-cutting announcements.

trends.name: Amazon AWS Cyber Attack & Cloud Risk
trends.summary: Iran strikes Amazon Web Services servers in Bahrain, directly targeting critical cloud infrastructure. Represents escalation from threats to actual cyber operations against US tech giants. Major risk to cloud-dependent businesses and market confidence in infrastructure resilience.

trends.name: Bitcoin Strategic Reserve & Mining Reshore
trends.summary: US Senators unveil 'Mined In America Act' to reshore Bitcoin mining and codify Bitcoin strategic reserve policy. Signals growing institutional/governmental acceptance of crypto as strategic asset class, with implications for supply chain policy and alternative reserves.

trends.name: April Stock Market Volatility & Seasonality Risk
trends.summary: S&P 500 historically gains in April, but this year is 'no sure bet' amid tightening financial conditions, oil crisis, and geopolitical tensions. April seasonality combined with macro headwinds creates elevated uncertainty for equity markets in coming weeks.

trends.name: Defense/Aerospace Spending & F-35 Delays
trends.summary: Switzerland advancing F-35A payments to March 2026 but withholding commitment until US provides fixed delivery dates. Patriot air defense system timeline unknown. NATO/allied defense spending uncertain, affecting aerospace-defense contractors amid geopolitical escalation.

trends.name: Retail Sector Turnaround Stalls
trends.summary: Nike stock dives on sales warning showing turnaround plan failing. Broader apparel/retail sector under pressure. Contrasts with upside signals in some segments (adidas fundamentals improving), signaling selective weakness in consumer discretionary as financial conditions tighten.

trends.name: Mortgage Refinance Demand Collapse
trends.summary: Weekly mortgage refinance demand down more than 40% in past month, indicating housing market slowdown and reduced household liquidity. Signals weakness in consumer balance sheets and reduced refinancing opportunities as rates remain elevated and financial conditions tighten.
